name: socrates
description: A demo user's first example on a freshly initialised model: two code-less assumptions and a code-less goal typed on the board (Model/Demo/Inbox.lean). Claude creates the vocabulary (a sort with its existence presupposition and instance, two predicates, a constant) in Vocabulary.lean, formalises the three cards directly below their blocks, checks, freezes, proves and finishes proved.
subject: Demo

steps.newString:
namespace Demo

/-- beings -/
axiom Being : Type
/-- there is at least one being -/
axiom Being.exists : Nonempty Being
instance : Nonempty Being := Being.exists
/-- is human -/
axiom Human : Being → Prop
/-- is mortal -/
axiom Mortal : Being → Prop
/-- Socrates -/
noncomputable opaque socrates : Being

end Demo

steps.oldString:
natural_name: All humans are mortal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: All humans are mortal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- All humans are mortal -/
abbrev all_humans_are_mortal : Prop := ∀ x : Being, Human x → Mortal x
axiom all_humans_are_mortal.holds : all_humans_are_mortal

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Socrates is a human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Socrates is a human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Socrates is a human -/
abbrev socrates_is_a_human : Prop := Human socrates
axiom socrates_is_a_human.holds : socrates_is_a_human

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Socrates is mortal
premises: all-humans-are-mortal, socrates-is-a-human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Socrates is mortal
premises: all-humans-are-mortal, socrates-is-a-human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Socrates is mortal -/
abbrev socrates_is_mortal : Prop := Mortal socrates

abbrev socrates_is_mortal : Prop := Mortal socrates
theorem socrates_is_mortal.holds : socrates_is_mortal :=
  all_humans_are_mortal.holds socrates socrates_is_a_human.holds

args.summary: Socrates is mortal follows from the two premises.
